dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000sasz](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000sasz) Magnitude 7.1 earthquake at 619.849 depth occurred on Feb 22 2026 65km W of Kudat. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 6.8285 longitude 116.2637. It impacted 39624 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
